subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should OpenClaw add a MiniMax M3-native video path now, and if so should it be limited to provider-owned media understanding or expand the core session/tool VideoContent contract?
rationale: Current main has only image-native chat/session content and MiniMax image media hooks, while the proposed path forwards raw video through provider transports and changes prompt/session semantics, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Split provider-first work
options.body: Keep this tracker open and sponsor narrow MiniMax provider/media-understanding pieces first, deferring core readVideo or generic VideoContent until the contract is approved.

options.title: Fold into generic video program
options.body: Move remaining decisions under the broader direct-video issue and treat MiniMax timestamp-scaling as provider-specific evidence there.

options.title: Decline native-video core work
options.body: Close the provider-specific tracker and require external/plugin experimentation until maintainers want raw video in OpenClaw-owned runtime paths.

recommendation.title: Split provider-first work
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and sponsor narrow MiniMax provider/media-understanding pieces first, deferring core readVideo or generic VideoContent until the contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is MiniMax provider ownership and prior MiniMax M3/model work.
